escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution via malformed protobuf messages. Any network endpoint that processes protobuf data is exploitable with zero authentication required.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends a crafted protobuf message to any gRPC or protobuf-parsing endpoint, triggering code injection at service privilege level.
escalations.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs; cd portal/Backend && npm update protobufjs

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Attacker-controlled template input achieves arbitrary code execution via type confusion in @partial-block parsing. Severity conditional on whether Handlebars is used with untrusted user input.
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any backend route passes user-supplied data into a Handlebars template, an attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes server-side.
escalations.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars; audit all Handlebars call sites for untrusted input

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: When Vitest UI server is active, any network attacker can read arbitrary files and execute code via the debug port (51204). Affects test infrastructure rather than production runtime.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker on same network as a developer running `vitest --ui` can read secrets from disk (env files, SSH keys) and execute arbitrary commands.
escalations.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest; cd portal/Frontend && npm update vitest; enforce CI policy: never run vitest --ui in networked environments

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search missing from app.ts — DependencyPicker broken at runtime
p2_findings.description: Route specified and tested but not registered. searchItems() API client calls a non-existent endpoint, making DependencyPicker non-functional.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register as app.use('/api/search', searchRouter)

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram absent from metrics.ts
p2_findings.description: 3 of 4 required Prometheus metrics present. dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing — /metrics will not emit it.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDurationHistogram to metrics.ts and instrument isReady() and detectCycle()

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
p2_findings.description: All three route files import workItemStore directly, violating CLAUDE.md architecture rule. Creates untestable coupling.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts, route all store calls through it

p2_findings.title: Tiered Merge Pipeline spec 0% implemented (FR-TMP-001 — FR-TMP-010)
p2_findings.description: 10 requirements, 0 implementation references. E2E directory contains only config files. No traceability enforcer coverage.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md to bring under enforcer scope; assign to TheATeam if active

p2_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js Malformed Request Server Crash (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Malformed gRPC request crashes the server process — denial of service with no authentication required.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update @grpc/grpc-js in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp Regular Expression Denial of Service (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Crafted route path strings trigger catastrophic backtracking, hanging the event loop.

p2_findings.title: @opentelemetry/sdk-node Prometheus Exporter Crash (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Malformed HTTP request to /metrics endpoint crashes the Prometheus exporter.

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented — no demo state on fresh startup
p3_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/seed.ts with idempotent seeding logic

p3_findings.title: Duplicate logger abstraction — src/logger.ts and src/utils/logger.ts coexist
p3_findings.recommendation: Designate utils/logger.ts as canonical; migrate all importers; delete shim

p3_findings.title: playwright.pipeline.config.ts has hardcoded artifact path — breaks on fresh checkout

p4_findings.title: eslint-disable without justification comment in DependencyPicker.tsx and useWorkItems.ts
p4_findings.recommendation: Add inline justification or fix exhaustive-deps warning properly
